question_text: What will McDonald's Corporation say during their next earnings call?
resolution_criteria:
If Supply Chain is said by any McDonald's Corporation representative (including the operator of the call) during the next McDonald's Corporation earnings call (including the Q+A), then the market resolves to Yes.
Video of the McDonald's Corporation earnings call will be primarily used to resolve the market; if a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, transcripts of the McDonald's Corporation earnings call will be used according to the news publications listed in the contract. The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word, must be used. Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. Please see full rules for more details.
